# braintrust_project_group_membership (Resource)

Manages one project membership in a Braintrust project group. Reference both the group and project so Terraform removes membership before destroying either object. Do not also set `member_projects` on the group resource. The API requires `create_acls` on the project to add it and `delete_acls` to remove it. Import with `project_group_id/project_id`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_group_id` (String) Project group ID.
- `project_id` (String) Member project ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in project_group_id/project_id form.
